create_channel: create a group or direct message channel in the open-webui chat system with specified members and access control
post_message_to_channel: post a new message to a channel with optional file attachments and threaded replies
get_channel_messages: retrieve paginated messages from a channel with thread replies, reactions, and user information
manage_channel_webhooks: create, update, or delete webhooks for a channel to send messages from external services
pin_and_unpin_message: pin or unpin a message in a channel to make it visible in the pinned messages list
